sql: select now() as consulta_em, data_publicacao, cultura, valor from public.mercado_quotes where papel='imea' and localidade='Mato Grosso' and cultura in ('soja','milho') and data_publicacao between date '2026-11-16' and date '2026-11-23' order by cultura, data_publicacao
select localidade, valor from public.mercado_quotes where papel='praca' and cultura='soja' and data_publicacao=date '2026-11-23' order by valor desc, localidade
